Mid 20th century. Lot page estimate A$150-200, current bid A$75.

viewing_check: Read the stamps on the back of each stem (want 'SARGISONS' plus 'STG' or 'STERLING'); weigh the six (about 45-50 g); check all six match and the gumnut finials and tendrils are intact; case lining and hinge.
